text: Amends the National Labor Relations Act to require secret ballot elections for union representation, establish a ninety-day decertification window if a union fails to bargain in good faith during initial negotiations, create a recurring ninety-day window period for decertification elections every two years, require two-thirds employee participation for union certification, prohibit blocking election petitions based on unfair labor practice settlements, and make no-raid agreements between labor organizations unfair labor practices.
